{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Check for sentinel values in biomarker_baseline
sentinel_count = (trial_df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999.0).sum()
print(f"Number of sentinel values in biomarker_baseline: {sentinel_count}")

# Check for missing values in responded
missing_responded = trial_df['responded'].isnull().sum()
print(f"Missing values in responded: {missing_responded}")

# Cross-tabulate arm vs responded
ct = pd.crosstab(trial_df['arm'], trial_df['responded'])
print("\nCross-tabulation of arm vs responded:")
print(ct)

# Compute response rates by arm
response_rates = trial_df.groupby('arm')['responded'].mean()
print("\nResponse rates by arm:")
print(response_rates)

# Compute treatment effect as difference in proportions (treatment - control)
treatment_effect = response_rates['treatment'] - response_rates['control']
print(f"\nTreatment effect (treatment - control): {treatment_effect:.4f}")"}
